name: copilot-token-economics
description: Measure and visualize GitHub Copilot token/AI-Credit economics — local-first web app + VS Code extension.

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.publish:webapp:dry-run: pnpm run check && pnpm --filter tokenmancer build:prod && pnpm --filter tokenmancer publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.publish:webapp: pnpm run check && pnpm --filter tokenmancer build:prod && pnpm --filter tokenmancer publish --no-git-checks --provenance --access public
